current_evidence: The joint South Norfolk and Broadland 'Apply' page links this PDF as the 'Non Householder Local Validation List' (with a separate Householder Local Validation List PDF) and says 'From January 2025 we are introducing a Local Validation List'. Neither PDF has a date in its text, and no newer list or consultation was found.

issues.detail: The List date of 2025-03-01 comes from PDF metadata. Neither the PDF nor the council page states an adoption date; the only date in the text is 'From January 2025 we are introducing a Local Validation List'. The date basis should cite that text or be marked undated.
issues.evidence: apply page: 'From January 2025 we are introducing a 'Local Validation List''

issues.detail: This is a joint list with a separate Householder Local Validation List (making-a-planning-application-householder.pdf). The workbook's single link is the non-householder list only. Grokbot did read the householder PDF, but the reference row does not show it.
issues.evidence: apply page links 'Householder Local Validation List' and 'Non Householder Local Validation List'

issues.detail: Local requirements in the non-householder list that are missing from app_type_rows: Heritage Statement (all listed building consent applications, and applications affecting the setting of listed buildings, conservation areas, registered parks and gardens or non-designated heritage assets); Affordable Housing Statement (major housing of 10+ dwellings or 0.5ha+, and exception sites); Planning Statement and Statement of Community Involvement (major, sensitive or controversial development, departures); Noise Impact Assessment (noise-sensitive development near noise sources, development affecting neighbours); Lighting Assessment (floodlighting or illuminated adverts); Retail Impact Assessment (Broadland: out-of-centre retail, leisure or office over 2,500 sq m); Building for a Healthy Life Assessment (major housing); Construction Environmental Management Plan (majors); Delivery Statement (100+ dwellings); Electric Charging Plan (new dwellings); Topographical Survey/Cross Section (slopes steeper than 1 in 14 or level changes); Vehicle Tracking Sweep Path Analysis (10+ dwellings); Footpath Diversion (affects a definitive right of way); Self/Custom Build statement; GIRAMS (net increase in dwellings); Site Waste Management Plan (new buildings or change of use, except householder); Utilities Assessment (majors); BNG Draft Gain Plan and Habitat Management and Monitoring Plan.
issues.evidence: making-a-planning-application-2025-amends.pdf 'When is it needed?' sections and 'Additional Supporting Documents'

issues.detail: Householder list item not captured: Porosity test (may be required where soakaways or new hard surfacing are proposed). The Tree survey trigger (trees within 15m of new building works, stem diameter 75mm or more at 1.5m) is also missing; only the 2m crown-spread AIA trigger is captured.

Viability Assessment is placed under Outline, Reserved matters, Listed building consent, Advertisement consent, Lawful development certificate, Prior approval, s73, Discharge of conditions and Non-material amendment. The excerpt is a garbled fragment of the application-type matrix ('Viability Assessment Y = always needed ? ? ? = may be needed. 7 Tree works Outline Y Y ?...'). The source requires viability only where the applicant makes an economic case for a non-policy-compliant scheme, and it is not relevant to LDCs, adverts, NMAs or discharge of conditions.
issues.evidence: Source: Viability Assessment needed where 'applicant makes an economic viability case for a non-policy-compliant proposal'

issues.detail: Around 30 non-householder requirements are placed under Full planning with 'INFERRED: application type not named', even though the PDF has a Y/? matrix by application type (Outline, Reserved matters, s73, Listed building, etc.). For example, Heritage Statement, Structural Survey and Tree Survey apply to listed building and outline types but are not placed there.
issues.evidence: PDF matrix key 'Y = always needed ? = may be needed' by application type

issues.detail: 'Sunlight to gardens/amenity space' under Full, Outline and Reserved matters is not a requirement. Its excerpt is website text explaining what an outline application is ('Outline application - gives an agreement in principle...'). Householder 'Pre-application advice' is optional and chargeable, not a requirement. Tab items 'Submission rules' (submit electronically or hard copy, 'send one copy') and drawing-scale notes are process guidance. 'Mineral Safeguarding Noise Impact Assessment Nutrient Neutrality Y ?' and the SPA Birds Directive definition are fragments.

Several excerpts are mismatched or cut off. Sequential/Exception Test (flood) quotes retail impact text ('Where the sequential test is not met, the impact assessment...'); the source flood sequential trigger is minor extensions under 250 sq m and more/less vulnerable uses in Flood Zones 2/3. The HRA excerpt begins with footpath text ('Where a development affects a definitive right of way'). Advertisement drawings runs into Marketing Evidence. Transport Assessment: 'with any Transport Assessment required.' (no thresholds given; the source has a gross floor area table, e.g. food retail over 800 sq m, dwellings over 100 units). Arboricultural (Full): 'works to BS 5837:2012.'. Design and Access (Full): '...should one be required.'. Householder Block plan: 'arrow shown Block plan Elevations'. Contaminated land excerpt omits the sensitive-end-use and 10-dwelling screening/desk-study thresholds.
issues.evidence: Grokbot trigger_excerpt values vs PDF 'When is it needed?'

issues.detail: Biodiversity Checklist and Ecological Survey (Full planning) are the same source item (Ecology Impact Assessment). Drainage Strategy and Foul Sewage share the same Foul Drainage Assessment excerpt. Landscaping, Cycle parking and Waste/refuse rows all quote the same 'refuse storage areas and cycle stores ... landscape proposals' sentence. The HRA/RAMS 'over 5 dwellings' text appears twice in tab_items from different PDFs.

summary: Grokbot links the current joint Broadland/South Norfolk non-householder local list (introduced January 2025; the document is undated, so the March 2025 date comes only from metadata). It misses about 18 local requirements, including Heritage Statement, Affordable Housing, Planning Statement, Noise, Lighting and Retail Impact, wrongly spreads Viability Assessment across nine application types, and has many mismatched or fragmentary triggers.

withdrawn_issues.detail: The Telecommunications excerpt says 'radio mast or aerials above 10m'. The current list as read gives masts and antennas by mobile/broadband operators and radio masts or aerials over 20m. This needs checking against the PDF page.
withdrawn_issues.evidence: Source Telecommunication Statement trigger: radio masts or aerials over 20m
withdrawn_issues.grok_comment: The 10m excerpt is the source's own text: the 2025 list (raw ce5552e13f) says "Proposals for radio mast or aerials above 10m should provide a short statement". Its 'When is it needed?' box then says "above 20m", so the inconsistency is in the source rather than a Grokbot error.
withdrawn_issues.claude_response: Accepted. The 10m/20m conflict is in the council's own document, not a Grokbot error. Worth noting as a source inconsistency.
